scenes.title_cn: 11岁的完美生活计划：在十一岁的时候…
scenes.title_en: The perfect-life plan at 11: at eleven, I …
scenes.context: 愿望大多实现却不觉完美。
sentences: 在十一岁的时候，我罗列过十几项长大以后完美的生活方式。
At eleven, I listed a dozen-plus items for a perfect adult life.
perfect-life list（完美计划）
明明清单里的东西大多数都实现了，但我却一点都没有觉得完美。
Most items came true, yet I feel none of the perfection.
no perfection（不觉得完美）
scenes.speak: At eleven, I listed a dozen-plus items for a perfect adult life. Most items came true, yet I feel none of the perfection.

scenes.title_cn: 那个计划的目的地：那是11岁的我能展…
scenes.title_en: The plan's destination: it was the most fl…
scenes.context: 开着凯迪拉克去康定看雪山。
sentences: 我发现了一条能看到远处雪山的路——康定、姑咱村。
I found a road where you could see distant snow mountains—Kangding, Gugu village.
snow mountains（远处雪山）
那是一辆凯迪拉克SRX，开着凯迪拉克去康定，这是那个计划的梗概。
It was a Cadillac SRX—driving a Cadillac to Kangding was the plan's outline.
Cadillac to Kangding（凯迪拉克去康定）
scenes.speak: I found a road where you could see distant snow mountains—Kangding, Gugu village. It was a Cadillac SRX—driving a Cadillac to Kangding was the plan's outline.

scenes.title_cn: 计划里的细节：老SRX已经很少见了，…
scenes.title_en: Details of the plan: old SRXs are rare now…
scenes.context: 复刻计划中的一个个细节。
sentences: 老SRX已经很少见了，但我借到了一辆今年最新的某款车，完美的延续。
Old SRXs are rare, but I borrowed the latest model—a perfect continuation.
perfect continuation（完美延续）
倒车不看雷达，是车技老练的标志。
Reversing without the radar was the mark of a seasoned driver.
seasoned driver（车技老练）
11岁的我还计划在车里听当时最喜欢的歌。
Eleven-year-old me planned to play my favorite song in the car.
favorite song（最喜欢的歌）
scenes.speak: Old SRXs are rare, but I borrowed the latest model—a perfect continuation. Reversing without the radar was the mark of a seasoned driver. Eleven-year-old me planned to play my favorite song in the car.

scenes.title_cn: 《理想的火锅》：11岁的那一天，应该…
scenes.title_en: The Ideal Hotpot: that day at eleven, I'd …
scenes.context: 完美标准一直在变，此刻尝到了那个隐喻。
sentences: 当时觉得男主有一套完美的火锅吃法这个行为很酷，所以才列下了那些计划。
I found his perfect hotpot routine cool, so I made those plans.
perfect hotpot routine（完美火锅吃法）
合数吃了一口，立刻决定和沙之共度余生。
He took one bite and immediately decided to spend his life with her.
decide to marry（共度余生）
但那坨黑黑的东西到底在隐喻什么，11岁的我百思不得其解，但此刻我好像尝到了它。
What the black lump symbolized, I couldn't figure out at 11—but now I think I've tasted it.
taste the metaphor（尝到隐喻）
scenes.speak: I found his perfect hotpot routine cool, so I made those plans. He took one bite and immediately decided to spend his life with her. What the black lump symbolized, I couldn't figure out at 11—but now I think I've tasted it.

scenes.title_cn: 结尾的感悟：我总在纠结过去想象的完美…
scenes.title_en: Final reflection: I keep agonizing over wh…
scenes.context: 完美标准一直在变化，不必执着过去。
sentences: 却忽略了完美的标准本来就是一直在变化的。
Yet the standard of perfection itself keeps changing.
the standard changes（标准在变）
现在所经历的感受和风险，是过去从没设想过的。
The feelings and risks now were never imagined in the past.
never imagined（从没设想）
scenes.speak: Yet the standard of perfection itself keeps changing. The feelings and risks now were never imagined in the past.

practice: At 11 I listed a dozen-plus perfect-life items.
Kangding, Gugu village, a Cadillac SRX.
Scarf for snow, radar-less reversing, snacks, songs.
One bite made him decide to marry her.
The perfect standard itself keeps changing.
pitfalls: The standard of perfection keeps changing.
Blame the present for not matching the past.
Feelings now were never imagined then.
当下的感受过去无从设想。
Even exact details may not bring perfection.
细节全对上也不一定完美。
The black lump's taste arrives with time.
隐喻需要时间才能尝到。
shifts: 用 the perfect-life list（完美计划）、the plan's outline（计划梗概）、childhood dream（少年愿望）
用 scarf for the snow（围巾看雪山）、radar-less reversing（倒车不看雷达）、spicy snacks（辣骨头）
用 the standard changes（标准在变）、taste the metaphor（尝到隐喻）、perfect standard（完美标准）
